# Jacob Vider

### Computational Physicist • Scientific Software Engineer • Quantitative Research

![](profile_picture.jpg){width=250 fig-align="right"}

I develop scientific software, image-processing pipelines, and statistical methods for astronomy, detector instrumentation, and large-scale data analysis.

My research has included detector calibration, spectroscopy, transient astronomy, machine learning, and scientific computing through work at NASA Goddard Space Flight Center, the University of Arizona, Columbia University, the New York Genome Center, Clark University, and Tel Aviv University. 

## Research Interests

- Astronomical Instrumentation
- Scientific Computing
- Image Processing
- Signal Processing
- Statistical Inference
- Machine Learning

## Featured Projects

### Detector Calibration Pipeline

Python pipeline for CCD calibration and detector characterization.

### Gaussian Deconvolution

Algorithms for restoring astronomical imaging data.

### Spectroscopic Analysis

Laboratory measurements of UV/Optical transmission filters.

### Time-Series Astronomy

Variability analysis using Lomb–Scargle periodograms and Bayesian modeling.

## Latest

Currently interested in scientific software engineering, quantitative research, and astronomical instrumentation.
